accountId.description: The account the query ran against.

queryState.description: Opaque state string. Pass to Principal/queryChanges to detect future changes.

canCalculateChanges.description: Whether Principal/queryChanges can be used with this query.

position.description: 0-based index of the first id in the ids array.

ids.description: The matching PrincipalIds in the requested order.

total.description: Total number of matching principals. Only present if calculateTotal was true.

limit.description: The limit applied. Only present if a limit was applied.
